execution.measurement: Sum of three foreground GpuJobService job wall times, including failed export and recovery; elapsedWallSeconds additionally includes diagnosis gaps. Excludes environment check, optimize and renders.
execution.rssMeasurement: Maximum /usr/bin/time -l maximum resident set size across attempts; not GPU memory.
execution.heavyCountDefinition: Other GPU/Blender compute-slot holders at each job boundary; 0/0 for all three attempts.

exportRecovery: Default export and non-remeshing-only retry failed on M1 unsupported float atomics. Successful recovery used the same decode checkpoint and built-in CPU pre-cap to avoid Metal simplification. No tool source or weights modified; run-time remesh override retained in ../../reproduce-export.py.
manifestCaveat: Upstream resume manifest params.seed=0 is the demo default; top-level seed=42 comes from the actual checkpoint and is authoritative. load_decode_bundle timing includes bake; use total or facade wall, not their sum.
reproducibility: One sampling run only; export recovered from checkpoint, not an independent replay. No byte-identity claim. Original Pixal3D replay remains the one-backend repeat trial.
